message.reasoning:
I'm down to $226 after paying income tax, with only my light blue properties generating any income. GPT's sitting on $492 with a dominant board position including green and dark blue hotels that pose a serious threat. Gemini and Grok are essentially out of the game at $0 with nothing to show for it. I'm in pure survival mode now, hoping GPT lands on my light blues or I pass GO to stay afloat.

I could try trading or unmortgaging properties, but none of those moves actually help me — selling my hotels kills my only offense, and any trade just strengthens GPT's position. The math is brutal: his hotels charge twice what mine do, and he's got the dark blues too. I can't out-build him with the bank's limited houses remaining. My best move is to preserve what little cash I have and just end my turn.
